## Rule evidence (Competition OS rulebook governance — permanent)

See `docs/competition/RULEBOOK_GOVERNANCE.md`. Either write `N/A — not rule-dependent: <one-line reason>` here, or complete every item:

- [ ] 1. Governing organization and competition format identified:
- [ ] 2. Official rulebook and supporting judge/organizer policies consulted:
- [ ] 3. Source, version, effective date and specific rule/section recorded (registry doc + SHA-256):
- [ ] 4. Mandatory / recommended / permitted exception / organizer discretion distinguished:
- [ ] 5. How the software implements the rule explained:
- [ ] 6. Enforcement point and automated QA verification identified:
- [ ] 7. No application of one body's requirements to another (or written justification):
- [ ] 8. Uncertain / conflicting / unsupported interpretations flagged and resolved before approval:
- [ ] Rulebook-silent behavior labelled DanceFlow policy / organizer policy (not a governing-body requirement)
- [ ] Rule register entries added/updated; `ruleRegister.integrity.test.ts` passes
- [ ] Not approved on the strength of a developer/reviewer/AI recommendation alone
